name: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
notes: UE4 DX11 → D3DMetal (Jedi Fallen Order / Hogwarts class). This is INTERGRADE (1462040), not Rebirth. Steam ships ff7remake_.exe in End/Binaries/Win64 (the underscore is part of the filename). -dx11 pins the Unreal RHI. Game-dir D3D12 agility SDK — if device creation fails, rename that folder. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
